sources.name: Operator affiliate accounts
sources.note: Referral URLs point to each venue's official domain with the operator's referral code; discount is what the user receives at registration.

binance.notes: Binance affiliate landing page (bsmk); user gets 20% fee discount, operator earns 40% rebate from the Binance Affiliate program.

okx.notes: User gets 20% fee discount via referral, operator earns 40% rebate from the OKX Affiliate program.

bitget.notes: Bitget affiliate link (partner.bitget.cafe); user gets 20% fee discount, operator earns 40% rebate from the Bitget Affiliate program.

gate.notes: User gets 20% fee discount via referral, operator earns 40% rebate from the Gate.io Partner program.

bybit.notes: Bybit official invite link; user gets 20% fee discount at registration.

mexc.notes: MEXC referral short link; user gets 20% fee discount at registration.

kucoin.notes: KuCoin referral link; user gets 20% fee discount at registration.

bingx.notes: BingX invite link on the official bingxdao.com invite domain; user gets 20% fee discount at registration.

blofin.notes: BloFin referral link; user gets 20% fee discount at registration.

bitvavo.notes: Bitvavo invite link; user gets 20% fee discount at registration.
